main_result.evidence: In this study, predicted bounding boxes produced by the Faster R-CNN model are quantitatively evaluated against ground-truth annotations, achieving peak localisation performance of approximately mIoU=0.44 and mAP@0.5=0.61

coder_notes: This paper evaluates three separate manufacturing tasks: (1) Casting Product binary image classification with YOLOv8n-cls (§6.1), (2) GC10-DET ('Defects Class and Location') bounding box object detection with Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN (§6.2, reporting peak mIoU=0.44 and mAP@0.5=0.61), and (3) MIMII acoustic anomaly detection with Isolation Forest (§6.3). In §6.2, it is unclear whether oversampling of under-represented classes was performed before or after the 80/20 stratified train/val split (Algorithm 2 lists split at step 5 and oversampling at step 6, whereas prose §6.2 mentions both without clarifying whether validation was oversampled). No baseline comparison or speed evaluation is performed on GC10-DET.
